**STEP 1 - Scene:** A plated lunch: two slices of flatbread-style pizza (tomato, mozzarella, red onion, meat), a green salad, diced grilled chicken, a few Kalamata-style olives, and two triangles of seeded brown cracker or bread. Overall it is a moderate single portion, roughly 280 g.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white square plate with rounded corners, roughly 26 cm across, so about 530 cm² of usable area. It fills most of the frame. A partial plate with green beans sits at the left edge and is excluded.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Pizza slices, mixed salad leaves with carrot and cucumber, diced grilled chicken, olives, seeded brown crackers. No visible dressing pool or oil sheen.

**STEP 4 - Volume:**
- Pizza: ~18% of area (95 cm²) × 1.5 cm ≈ 140 ml
- Salad leaves: ~22% (115 cm²) × 3 cm ≈ 345 ml × 0.2 (airy) ≈ 69 g
- Chicken: ~12% (63 cm²) × 1.5 cm ≈ 95 ml × 0.9 ≈ 85 g
- Olives: ~5% (26 cm²) × 1 cm ≈ 26 ml × 0.9 ≈ 23 g
- Crackers: ~6% (32 cm²) × 0.8 cm ≈ 26 ml × 0.6 ≈ 15 g

**STEP 5 - Grams:** Pizza ≈ 0.6 g/ml → ~85 g. Total ≈ 277 g.

**STEP 6 - Energy:**
- Pizza: 85 g × 260 kcal/100 g ≈ 220 kcal
- Salad: 69 g × 20 kcal/100 g ≈ 14 kcal
- Chicken: 85 g × 165 kcal/100 g ≈ 140 kcal
- Olives: 23 g × 115 kcal/100 g ≈ 26 kcal
- Crackers: 15 g × 300 kcal/100 g ≈ 45 kcal
- Total ≈ 445 kcal

**STEP 7 - Sanity check:** About 280 g with roughly 445 kcal fits a light-to-moderate lunch with two pizza slices and a good salad and protein portion. The pizza could be thinner than assumed, so the estimate has a wide uncertainty of about ±25%.
